note: P4278 (Pro 26:2) — like a fluttering sparrow, a causeless curse does not alight.

dims.v: impotent malediction — the undeserved curse that finds no rest
the curse that is causeless — the undeserved malediction which, like a flitting bird, never lands or takes hold, powerless where there is no ground for it
the empty curse that finds no place to settle

qelalah (curse) — 'a CURSE that is causeless does not alight'; an undeserved curse has no power to land — it flutters off like a bird with nowhere to perch. Innocence is a shield against malediction (cf Num 23:8).
